## Description and Rationale

I'm a student based in Almaty, currently studying in Taldykorgan, with a strong interest in AI and data science. I enjoy exploring how machine learning can be applied to real, practical problems rather than staying purely theoretical.

I decided to register for the PRC Data Challenge because it combines two things I care about: working with real-world, open aviation data and tackling a genuinely useful prediction problem. I'm excited by the open-science format of the challenge — sharing code, documenting methodology, and potentially contributing to published research — and I see this as a great opportunity to sharpen my data science skills on a large-scale, real dataset while contributing something meaningful to the aviation community.
